name: Miso-Chili Butter Gnocchi with Green Beans, Arugula & Parmesan (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Small dice butter. Place in a small bowl along with miso paste, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce. Mash with the back of a spoon to combine the miso-butter and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 ½ tbsp miso paste, white
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ (16 oz) pkg strawberries
¾ lb green beans
½ (5 oz) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise. Place on a plate and set aside.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, trim and halve green beans crosswise. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (16 oz) pkg potato gnocchi
1 tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the gnocchi is cooking, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green beans, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are fork-tender, 3-4 minutes. Transfer a ⅔-cup of beans to the plate with the strawberries and set aside. (Reserve skillet with remaining beans and bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place 1 cup of cooked gnocchi in the reserved bowl and set aside. Add remaining gnocchi and miso-butter to the skillet with the green beans. Continue to cook, stirring often, until butter is melted and gnocchi are coated in sauce, about 30 seconds.
Add arugula to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat. Set aside.
Add Parmesan and butter to the bowl with the gnocchi, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
1 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide Parmesan-butter gnocchi, green beans, and strawberries between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide miso-chili butter gnocchi and veggies between plates, then top with additional Parmesan and sesame seeds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
2 tsp sesame seeds
